body.purpose: Primary content, descriptions, list items. Capped at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, sort headers, filter chips, nav items. 600 weight.

mono.purpose: Numbers, metrics, URLs, container IDs — anything read as data, not prose.

shadows.name: ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for hover states on interactive cards. Light theme.

shadows.name: ambient-md
shadows.purpose: Popovers, tooltips, dropdown menus. Light theme.

shadows.name: ambient-lg

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions. Exponential deceleration — no bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard transitions: page navigations, drawer open/close, view transitions.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Deliberate reveals: modal entrance, skeleton shimmer.

components.name: Danger Badge

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on screen. Emerald-teal-cyan gradient with green-tinted glow. Used for 'Add server' CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #14b8a6 50%, #0891b2); color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.45); transition: opacity 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cbd5e1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action that doesn't compete with the primary CTA. Transparent background, border on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #0f172a; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cbd5e1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Full-width search field with leading icon and clear button. Used in the containers panel filter bar.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 32px 0 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 13px; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-search-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(16 185 129 / 0.20); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Pill-shaped route indicator in the app header. Active state uses the brand gradient.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #ffffff !important; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #14b8a6 50%, #0891b2) !important; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -8px rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.5); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Rounded-pill filter toggle. Active state uses emerald accent with tinted background and border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #64748b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s, color 0.12s, border-color 0.12s; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #0f172a; } .ds-chip-active { background: rgb(16 185 129 / 0.10); color: #10b981; border-color: rgb(16 185 129 / 0.30); } .ds-chip-count { opacity: 0.7; }

narrative.overview:
LiveDock is a ship's bridge in miniature. Every surface element carries signal or stays out of the way. The interface is dense enough to diagnose a problem in seconds, calm enough to glance at for hours. It rejects the Grafana model of infinite panels, nested menus, and configuration sprawl. It also rejects the generic Bootstrap admin look — banded table rows, card-grid sameness, 'template' feeling.

The aesthetic is botanical precision: cool slate neutrals with an emerald-teal-cyan accent that feels alive without shouting. Dark and light themes are equal citizens — neither is an afterthought. The dark theme is meant for 2am incident response in a dim room; the light theme for daytime ops under office fluorescents.
keyCharacteristics: Signal-dense, not information-dense. Empty space is earned.
Predictable layout — elements never move or surprise on refresh.
Tactile interactions: hover lifts, focus rings are visible, active states are instant.
Flat elevation by default. Shadows appear only for popovers and dropdowns.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The emerald accent appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point — if everything is green, nothing is a signal.

rules.name: The Slate Bed Rule
rules.body: All neutrals live in the slate hue (approx 210-220°). No pure grays. No warm grays. The cool cast is intentional and consistent across both themes.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Any number, metric, URL, or identifier that the user reads as data (not prose) must use the mono stack.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, popover, modal). A card or container that casts a shadow while idle is wrong.

dos: Do use the brand gradient exclusively for the single most important action on screen.
Do use the mono stack for any number, metric, URL, or identifier.
Do keep spacing generous at the section level (20-32px gaps) while keeping internal density tight (4-12px).
Do let empty states earn their screen space.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. Skeleton shimmers, view transitions, and hover animations all disable.
Do use the full 10-stop slate scale. Tinted neutrals only — no pure grays, no warm grays.
donts: Don't use the emerald accent decoratively. If it's not marking an interactive element or a live signal, remove it.
Don't use Grafana-style infinite panels, nested menus, or configuration overload.
Don't use generic Bootstrap patterns: banded table rows, card-grid sameness, 'template' feeling.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. Emphasis comes from weight or size.
Don't use glassmorphism or blurs decoratively. Flat terrain by default.
Don't use hero-metric templates (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent) as a repeated pattern.
Don't nest cards inside cards. A card is an outer container.
Don't let elements move or change position on refresh. The layout must be predictable.
